name: settlement-credential-phish
description: A fake settlement notice that borrows the legal-notice sender name to ask for a password. The settlement wording is what lowers the impersonation finding for genuine notices, so this is the case that proves it buys an attacker nothing: asking for credentials still makes it an impersonation-and-credential attempt.

email.subject: You are owed a settlement refund
email.bodyText:
Dear customer,

You have been identified as eligible for a settlement refund of 214.60. To release the payment, sign in to your PayPal account and confirm your password within 24 hours, or the refund will be forfeited.

Claim the refund now.
